"""Root-reviewed immutable external fixture bootstrap; no body/model patch."""
import base64,hashlib,os,pathlib,sys,zlib
ENTRY_SHA256 = 'c53fd3a5ff725a2a9639bb822cfa1b1900c0b9b103fd46dbee1480fad9d4a852'
EXPECTED_SHA256 = '408999e6276bb66233e575bfc7b5826143cb55553c16a311a8b3531d58a0f275'
ENTRY_COMPRESSED_BASE64 = ''
EXPECTED_COMPRESSED_BASE64 = ''
project=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();raw=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
if raw!=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('PROBATA_OUTPUT','/missing-root-marker')).resolve() or not raw.is_dir():
 raise SystemExit('exact Linux coordinator output root required')
for filename,encoded,want in [('qualified-grow-entry.py',ENTRY_COMPRESSED_BASE64,ENTRY_SHA256),('qualified-grow-expected.json',EXPECTED_COMPRESSED_BASE64,EXPECTED_SHA256)]:
 data=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(encoded))
 if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=want:raise SystemExit('immutable external recipe byte pin differs')
 with (raw/filename).open('xb')as stream:stream.write(data)
os.execv(sys.executable,[sys.executable,'-B',str(raw/'qualified-grow-entry.py'),'--expected',str(raw/'qualified-grow-expected.json'),'--project',str(project),'--output',str(raw/'qualified-grow-profile')])
